title: Special Delivery: The Pedalling Pelican
description: A white pelican leans into a sea-green delivery bicycle, its enormous golden bill and hanging throat pouch leading the way. Swept black-tipped wings steer, orange webbed feet work staggered pedals, and a wicker basket carries fish.
